title: CSV parser follows RFC 4180 quoting and line counting
scenario: Parse text with quoted commas, doubled quotes (""), a newline inside quotes, CRLF, LF and a lone CR as record separators, and a file without a trailing newline. Check each record's starting line.
expected: Fields are unquoted correctly, embedded newlines stay in the field, every record reports the line it starts on, and the final record is kept without a trailing newline. Lone CR currently ends a record.

source: [branch] src/rdm/lookupCsv.ts readLookupCsv; existing scripts/test-rdm-lookup-csv-load.cjs (BOM, CRLF test)
title: Export with BOM, CRLF, blank lines and reordered mixed-case headers loads cleanly
scenario: Feed readLookupCsv a file starting with a UTF-8 BOM, using CRLF, with blank lines between rows, headers in a different order and case, and one extra column named Notes.
expected: No errors; rows map to the right values; line numbers still count blank lines; exactly one warning says ignored column Notes.

source: [branch] src/rdm/lookupCsv.ts readLookupCsv; existing scripts/test-rdm-lookup-csv-load.cjs (errors with lines)
title: Structural and row-level CSV problems are reported with line numbers
scenario: Submit files that are empty, header-only, missing required columns, in the old Code/Source/Value at Source layout, with an unclosed quote, and rows with an empty code, a code containing '/', a bad boolean or non-numeric date.
expected: Each case returns a specific error with the CSV line (header is line 1) and no types are produced for structural errors. Row errors name the offending line.

title: Duplicate code fields and duplicate mappings in one file are rejected, not merged twice
scenario: CSV where code A sets enabled/startDate/endDate on two rows, and where code A maps the same source and source code twice; plus the same code under two different lookup types.
expected: Two errors naming both lines each; no duplicated mapping in the draft; the same code under two types stays two separate values without an error.

title: CSV size and row limits accept the boundary and reject one past it
scenario: Build a file with exactly 10000 data rows and one with 10001; call readLookupCsv with byteLength exactly 2 MB and 2 MB + 1.
expected: 10000 rows and 2 MB parse without a limit error; 10001 rows gives 'limit is 10000' and 2 MB + 1 gives 'larger than 2 MB'; neither case throws.

title: Appending to an existing code resends the stored value unchanged (CSV replace fix)
scenario: Stored code B has two mappings, version, enabled=true and an endDate; the CSV row for B adds a new SAP mapping and also states enabled=false and a different endDate. Run a load against a stubbed service.
expected: The POSTed element for B equals the fetched value with only the SAP mapping added; enabled, endDate, version and the existing mappings are untouched; a warning says stored values are kept.

title: Conflicting mapping value is skipped and the stored value wins
scenario: Stored B maps BvD code B to 'Business'; CSV row says BvD code B is 'Biz'. A second row repeats an identical stored mapping. Plan and load.
expected: The conflicting row is skipped with a warning naming its line, the stored 'Business' is never overwritten, the identical row counts as already present, and nothing is sent if nothing is appendable.

title: mergeLookupValue does not mutate the fetched stored value
scenario: Deep-freeze a stored lookup value object, call mergeLookupValue with a draft that appends a mapping, then reuse the same stored object for planWarnings and unknownSourceWarnings.
expected: No exception from the frozen input; the stored object deep-equals its snapshot afterwards; the merged result is a separate copy containing the new mapping.

source: [branch] src/rdm/lookupCsv.ts loadOutcomes; src/rdm/lookupLoadBridge.ts (send loop); existing scripts/test-rdm-lookup-csv-load.cjs
title: Partial failure reports every code as added, not-stored, not-sent or unconfirmed
scenario: Load 250 codes with the second chunk POST failing with HTTP 400, then with a 401 that cannot be refreshed, then with the re-fetch itself failing.
expected: Counts show added 100, not-stored 100, not-sent 50 for the 400 case; the 401 case stops with an api-error 401 message; without a re-fetch sent codes are unconfirmed. No code is reported added unless a response or the re-fetch holds it.

source: [branch] src/rdm/lookupLoadBridge.ts handleLookupLoadRequest (approve gate); src/extension.ts approve dialog
title: No write reaches RDM without modal approval; plan mode never writes

title: Bridge refuses request paths that escape the workspace or the tenant's own config
scenario: Send csvFile and rdmConfigFile with '..' segments, backslash '..\\' forms, an absolute path on another drive, a path outside the workspace root, and an RDM/<id>/config.json that belongs to a different tenant folder.
expected: Every case returns failed/invalid-request with no file read beyond the check and zero fetch or post calls. Existing '../' and '/etc' cases keep passing; backslash and other-drive cases are added.

title: Bridge accepts Windows path spellings of the same workspace files

expected: Valid in-workspace paths resolve and the config path matches the tenant's rdmConfigUri despite case and separator differences; the request reaches status planned.

title: RDM service host outside the trusted allowlist is never contacted

expected: Untrusted hosts throw UntrustedHostError and the fetch stub is called zero times; trusted hosts send the request with the token only to that host. Today only the POST case is asserted.

title: RDM request URLs encode ids and cannot gain extra path segments
scenario: Capture the URL passed to a stub fetch for rdmTenantId and lookupTypeName values containing '/', '..', '?' and spaces, and tenantId likewise for the physical configuration call.
expected: URLs follow /reltio/tenants/{id}, /configuration/{id}, /lookups/{id}/{type} with encodeURIComponent applied; no extra segment or query is introduced. The real functions are exercised, not a re-implemented URL.

title: RDM write failures map to readable ReltioApiError messages
scenario: Stub POST and PUT responses: Reltio error envelope, plain text, empty body, body longer than MAX_ERROR_BODY_CHARS, and 401.
expected: Envelope gives 'HTTP <status>: <message> <detail>' without duplicate text; empty body gives 'HTTP <status>.'; long body is truncated with an ellipsis; 401 gives ReltioApiError 'Unauthorized (401)' with statusCode 401.

title: PUT RDM configuration sends the saved text verbatim with JSON content type
scenario: Call putRdmConfiguration with a body string that has custom whitespace and key order, capturing the stub fetch request.
expected: Method is PUT, URL ends /configuration/{rdmTenantId}, Content-Type is application/json, body is byte-identical to the input string (no re-serialization), and the Authorization header carries the token.

title: Panel messages are shape-checked, trimmed and cannot carry a target
scenario: Pass messages with wrong types, unknown type, extra fields such as rdmTenantId or lookupTypeName, padded strings, duplicate codes, a code containing '/', and 101 codes.
expected: Malformed messages return undefined; extra fields are dropped; text is trimmed; content-rule breaches return kind rejected listing every error; more than 100 codes is rejected.

title: Lookup values panel HTML is nonce-protected and escapes service data
scenario: Render the panel for data containing <script>, quotes and markup in codes, sources and suggestions, twice.
expected: Every script and style carries the CSP nonce, no inline event handlers, markup is escaped, the script body contains no interpolated data, and nonce and render token differ per render.

title: Service URI cache is keyed per tenant, ignores empty URIs and never persists
scenario: Remember URIs for two tenants in two environments, remember an empty string, clear the cache. Also inspect the module source for fs, vscode or storage use.
expected: Recall returns the right URI per environment and tenant only; an empty URI is not stored; clear empties the cache; the module has no file or storage writes (the physical-config response holds credentials).

title: RDM discovery returns only service URI and tenant ids, and tolerates bad input
scenario: Pass a physical configuration with messaging credentials and storage accounts next to rdmConfig, plus null, strings, missing rdmConfig, blank serviceUri and rdmTenants with invalid entries.
expected: Result has exactly serviceUri and rdmTenantIds, with no other field leaking; bad shapes give serviceUri undefined and an empty list without throwing; valid ids keep order.

title: RDM skeletons, allowlist and subtree keep their documented shape
scenario: Build lookup type and source skeletons, check RDM_CREATABLE_ROOT_KEYS, collect labels from malformed sections, and walk getRdmRootChildren, getRdmFolderChildren and the parent functions on a fixture with an unknown array key.
expected: Skeletons include uri, label and defaults; only lookupTypes and sources are creatable; unknown sections are skipped; empty sections are omitted; parents round-trip.

expected: Second run creates, moves and reports nothing. Mid-pair failure reports failed once, config sits at its new path, the stray legacy baseline is not moved on rerun (pins current behavior), and the healthy tenant still moves.

title: Apply RDM Configuration refuses to run without a baseline and warns on server drift
